title: Microsoft is rewiring itself for the AI era, on offence and defence
excerpt: Microsoft is remaking its own stack for the AI era, on both offence and defence. This week it moved on two fronts. It began pulling OpenAI’s models out of its most-used apps to cut costs. And it set a date to kill the text-message login, blaming a wave of AI-powered phishing. The two announcements look […]
content_html:
Microsoft is remaking its own stack for the AI era, on both offence and defence. This week it moved on two fronts. It began pulling OpenAI’s models out of its most-used apps to cut costs. And it set a date to kill the text-message login, blaming a wave of AI-powered phishing.

The two announcements look nothing alike, yet they share a driver.

Swapping OpenAI out

Microsoft is replacing OpenAI’s image-generating models with its own technology in PowerPoint and Bing, Bloomberg reported. “It’s faster, it’s cheaper, it’s higher quality, it drives better retention,” Microsoft’s AI chief Mustafa Suleyman said.

The decisive word is cheaper. Suleyman said the company’s own MAI models run about 85% cheaper than OpenAI’s in PowerPoint.

The 💜 of EU tech

The latest rumblings from the EU tech scene, a story from our wise ol' founder Boris, and some questionable AI art. It's free, every week, in your inbox. Sign up now!

Microsoft still gets OpenAI’s models free under their partnership. But it pays to run them, and that compute bill is enormous. It began replacing OpenAI and Anthropic text models in its office apps earlier this month, matching GPT-5.6 on common Excel tasks at lower cost.

Images are next. MAI models now run in more than half of all Microsoft products, and the company is testing them in every one. T-Mobile and Britain’s EasyJet are already using its voice models in their call centres.

The subtext is independence.

Suleyman, the DeepMind co-founder hired last year to run its own AI push, was brought in to loosen the reliance on OpenAI. Microsoft has poured more than $100 billion into that partnership. Every app it moves in-house makes OpenAI look a little less like a partner, and a little more like a vendor.

The death of the SMS login

The second move is defensive. From 1 September, passkeys become the default sign-in for Entra ID, Microsoft’s business identity service. From 1 February 2027, the company will stop sending its own SMS and voice-call codes altogether. Windows Hello and FIDO2 security keys stay.

The humble text-message code is being shown the door.

The reason is AI. “The AI era demands stronger, phishing-resistant authentication,” Microsoft said. Its own figures explain why. AI-assisted phishing emails get a 54% click-through rate, against 12% for conventional ones.

AI has made scams far more convincing, so the weakest login method has to go. Passkeys help because an attacker would need the victim’s actual device, not just a stolen code.

Neither move is as clean as it sounds. Microsoft frames its models as matching OpenAI only on “common” tasks, and much of the rollout is still in testing. Passkeys are no silver bullet either, which is why biometrics and hardware keys remain.

Still, the through-line is plain. AI is both the thing Microsoft wants to run more cheaply, and the reason it has to lock its doors differently. Even Google now lets you sign in with a selfie. The password’s long goodbye is speeding up.

content_html_zh:
微软正在为人工智能时代重塑自己的进攻和防守堆栈。 本周它在两个方面发生了变化。 它开始将 OpenAI 的模型从最常用的应用程序中撤出，以削减成本。 它还设定了终止短信登录的日期，并将其归咎于人工智能驱动的网络钓鱼浪潮。

这两个公告看起来毫无相似之处，但它们共享一个驱动程序。

替换 OpenAI

据彭博社报道，微软正在用自己的 PowerPoint 和 Bing 技术取代 OpenAI 的图像生成模型。 微软人工智能负责人穆斯塔法·苏莱曼 (Mustafa Suleyman) 表示：“它更快、更便宜、质量更高、留存率更高。”

决定性的一句话就是便宜。 Suleyman 表示，该公司自己的 MAI 模型在 PowerPoint 中的运行成本比 OpenAI 的模型便宜约 85%。

欧盟科技的💜

来自欧盟科技界的最新传言、我们明智的创始人鲍里斯的故事，以及一些值得怀疑的人工智能艺术。 每周都会免费发送到您的收件箱中。 立即注册！

在他们的合作关系下，微软仍然免费获得 OpenAI 的模型。 但运行它们是值得的，而且计算费用是巨大的。 本月早些时候，它开始在其办公应用程序中替换 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 文本模型，以更低的成本在常见 Excel 任务上匹配 GPT-5.6。

接下来是图像。 MAI 模型现在运行在一半以上的 Microsoft 产品中，并且该公司正在对每一款产品进行测试。 T-Mobile 和英国 EasyJet 已经在其呼叫中心使用其语音模型。

潜台词是独立。

DeepMind 联合创始人 Suleyman 去年受聘负责自己的人工智能业务，他的加入是为了放松对 OpenAI 的依赖。 微软已为这一合作伙伴关系投入了超过 1000 亿美元。 OpenAI 内部移动的每一款应用程序都让 OpenAI 看起来不像是合作伙伴，而更像是供应商。

短信登录的消亡

第二个动作是防守。 从 9 月 1 日起，密钥成为 Microsoft 企业身份服务 Entra ID 的默认登录方式。 从 2027 年 2 月 1 日起，该公司将完全停止发送自己的短信和语音呼叫代码。 Windows Hello 和 FIDO2 安全密钥保留。

简陋的短信代码正在被拒之门外。

原因就是人工智能。 微软表示：“人工智能时代需要更强大的、防网络钓鱼的身份验证。” 它自己的数据解释了原因。 AI 辅助的网络钓鱼电子邮件的点击率为 54%，而传统邮件的点击率为 12%。

人工智能使诈骗变得更有说服力，因此最弱的登录方法必须被淘汰。 万能钥匙很有用，因为攻击者需要受害者的实际设备，而不仅仅是窃取的代码。

这两个举动都不像听起来那么干净。 微软将其模型设计为仅在“常见”任务上与 OpenAI 相匹配，并且大部分部署仍在测试中。 万能钥匙也不是灵丹妙药，这就是生物识别技术和硬件密钥仍然存在的原因。

尽管如此，贯穿的路线还是很简单的。 人工智能既是微软希望以更便宜的方式运行的东西，也是它必须以不同方式锁定大门的原因。 甚至 Google 现在也允许您通过自拍照登录。 密码的漫长告别正在加速。
